name: sample-file-review
description: Inspect a sample file and write a short read-only review for local Langfuse tracing demo

steps.prompt:
You are running the sample-file-review workflow in an isolated demo workspace.

Task: inspect {{target_file}} only. Do not edit, create, or delete any project source files except writing the review artifact path below.

Write a short review (4-6 bullets) covering: purpose, clarity, one risk or edge case, and one improvement idea. Save it to .kiro/workflow-output/sample-review.md.

Finish by calling send_message with severity success and a one-line summary.
